scientific_question: Can activation-conditioned diagonal modulation between fixed orthogonal FHT mixers rotate a compact c_proj latent image with routed hidden context and recover the same-gauge dense expert write at 384x or 256x coordinates?

target_and_gauge.isolation: Use the terminal same-run router and terminal same-run c_fc on both base and target. The only target action is terminal c_proj minus step-zero c_proj, so no tensor is transplanted across runs and dense routers remain an explicitly allowed negligible parameter set.

paper_link.distinction: The paper enriches a fixed projection with latent modulation. Here the modulation is channel-wise and activation-conditioned because the measured deficit is a context-dependent residual write. The fixed signs/FHT mixers are never learned; this is not LoRA or a learned dense basis.
paper_link.prior_closed_family: Ordinary ProductFHT used learned diagonals but its materialized W(z) was independent of the current activation and recovered only ambient-coordinate expectation. The proposed G(h) is between mixers, so Im(J_z g(z;h)) rotates with routed hidden state h.

measured_deficit.diagnosis: Static images can identify a functional direction but cannot represent its routed context dependence; c_proj is the residual-write bottleneck and is isolated here.

mechanism.notation: For routed expert e, h_e is its post-GELU hidden activation, P pads hidden width to the next power of two, H is normalized FHT, and D_s are fixed seeded sign diagonals.
mechanism.properties: The map is linear in trainable z for exact matrix-free least squares, nonlinear in h, uses no labels or errors at inference, and has an activation-dependent tangent image. beta=0 is the identical-coordinate static-operator ablation.
mechanism.trust_and_scale: Every context vector is per-token RMS normalized and the (1+u) gate is divided by sqrt(2). Overall operator scale is immaterial to exact coordinate fitting; ridge is tied to the normal-operator trace.

evaluation.fit: Matrix-free CGLS independently fits z on discovery A and B to the exact same-gauge terminal c_proj residual write.
evaluation.primary_metric: Exact held-out c_proj residual-write recovery after applying the nonlinear activation-conditioned operator.
secondary_metrics: heldout action agreement between independently fitted banks
improvement over beta=0 with identical coordinates

ablations_and_controls.beta_zero: Remove only activation-conditioned modulation by setting G(h)=I, retaining signs, mixers, coordinates, tokens, fitting, and target.
ablations_and_controls.zero_action: Base uses terminal router/c_fc and step-zero c_proj; target uses terminal router/c_fc/c_proj.
ablations_and_controls.anti_leakage: Terminal c_proj appears only as the regression target and held-out scorer. It never determines signs, FHT axes, context gates, rank, seeds, or thresholds. Held-out tokens never enter fitting.

decision_rule.pass: Passing both data banks authorizes only a separately preregistered same-gauge multi-phase shadow rollout and initialization-fit oracle. It does not authorize training.
decision_rule.partial: If only three-factor passes, retain 256x c_proj as the only live candidate; do not increase factors.
decision_rule.fail: Reject activation-conditioned FHT modulation at this budget and do not retry beta, rank, signs, or learning rate without a new measured residual decomposition.
decision_rule.systems: This offline oracle is expected under five minutes and must be directly foreground-polled. No MFU gate or watchdog is appropriate unless runtime crosses five minutes.
